died.name: William Laud
died.cause: spoken as the signal to the executioner at his beheading for treason

died.name: Benjamin Parsons
died.last_words: I feel that I must come like the poor publican, like the thief on the cross, and like Mary Magdalene. I must come to the foot of the cross and be saved just in the same manner as they.

died.name: Mary Russell Mitford
died.last_words: If you wish for another cheerful evening with your old friend, there is no time to be lost.

died.name: Lyman Beecher
died.last_words: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith; henceforth there is laid up for me a crown, which God, the righteous Judge, will give me at that day. That is my testimony-write it down.-That is my testimony.

died.name: Frederick Harding Turner
died.cause: shortly before being killed by a sniper during World War I
died.last_words: By Jove, that has deafened my right ear.

died.name: Coco Chanel
died.last_words: You see, this is how you die.

born.name: James Gardiner
born.cause: to a Jacobite officer after being mortally wounded at the Battle of Prestonpans
born.last_words: You are fighting for an earthly crown; I am going to receive a heavenly one.

born.name: Ethan Allen
born.cause: on being told the angels were waiting for him
born.last_words: Waiting, are they? Waiting, are they? Well, God damn 'em, let 'em wait!

born.name: Michel Ney
born.cause: When executed by firing squad, he refused to wear a blindfold and was allowed the right to give the order to fire himself
born.last_words: Soldiers, when I give the command to fire, fire straight at my heart. Wait for the order. It will be my last to you. I protest against my condemnation. I have fought a hundred battles for France, and not one against her ... Soldiers, fire!

born.name: Vicente Huidobro
born.cause: after regaining consciousness, he confessed to his loved ones that he was afraid and made his friend Henriette Petit cry when he stared at her and shouted this expression

born.name: Sal Mineo
born.last_words: Oh God! No! Help! Someone help!

born.name: Jim Croce
born.cause: in a letter written to his wife Ingrid shortly before he boarded a plane that killed him
born.last_words: Remember, it's the first 60 years that count and I've got 30 to go. I love you.
